queries: 2023 AI startups more than quarter venture funding November 2023 PitchBook

sources_considered.why: The post's linked source and the dataset provider's own analysis directly establish the intended scope and share.
Shows why the U.S. finding cannot be generalized to global funding.
Primary contextual evidence that aggregate AI fundraising strength did not imply uniformly easy fundraising.

evidence_items.locator: Opening paragraph; subsequent section AI gets a bigger piece of a smaller pie

receipt.public_excerpt: More than 1 in 4 dollars invested in American startups this year has gone to an artificial intelligence-related company, Crunchbase data shows.

evidence_items.explanation: Crunchbase directly reports a share above 25% for American startups. Its accompanying analysis reports increasing AI investment amid a broad funding contraction, supporting the relative-resilience reading.

receipt.public_excerpt: Companies categorized as AI in Crunchbase raised $25 billion in the first half of 2023, representing 18% of global funding.

evidence_items.explanation: The global first-half share was below 25%. Geography and measurement window differ, so this limits generalization rather than contradicting the linked U.S. result.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph following Global AI funding reached $8.3B in Q3’23

receipt.public_excerpt: AI deals slipped even further, declining by 18% QoQ to 501 — the lowest quarterly level since 2017.​

evidence_items.explanation: Falling global deal counts caution against reading reliable as easy financing for every AI startup. Deal count is not the claimed U.S. dollar share.

unresolved_gaps: The linked source does not provide a fresh measurement through November 20.
Aggregate dollar totals do not measure individual startups' probability of obtaining funding.
